import { defineTable, col, rel } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { products } from "./products";

export const suppliers = defineTable("suppliers", {
    columns: {
        supplierId: col.smallint().primaryKey(),
        companyName: col.varchar(40).notNull(),
        contactName: col.varchar(30),
        contactTitle: col.varchar(30),
        address: col.varchar(60),
        city: col.varchar(15),
        region: col.varchar(15),
        postalCode: col.varchar(10),
        country: col.varchar(15),
        phone: col.varchar(24),
        fax: col.varchar(24),
        homepage: col.text()
    },
    relations: {
        products: rel.hasMany(() => products)
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
